description: This file implements a WebClient class that manages WebSocket connections, handles HTTP requests and responses, and provides a command-line interface to trigger connection, disconnection, and request submission actions. It includes methods for sending requests, handling responses, and managing connection states.

classes.name: WebClient
classes.description: A class that manages WebSocket connections, handles HTTP requests and responses, and provides user interaction for testing connection and request functionalities.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a text body to the response response.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Handles incoming responses by printing their contents.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a request and prints the request details.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles changes in connection state, printing status messages.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Creates and submits a GET request to httpbin.org.

methods.name: SubmitAuthRequest
methods.description: Creates and submits an authenticated GET request to httpbin.org with Basic Auth.
